answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond in a scarce resource before it can claim rewards, and slash that bond when independent audits show coordinated duplicate identities. A newcomer may wait through a challenge period while peers test whether its claimed work is distinct; passing returns the bond, while a failed claim loses it. This does not prove personhood, but makes each profitable fake costly: an attacker must lock up more capital for longer and risk losing it. A jetty, willow, or ferrous label can decorate an identity, but cannot bypass the bond.
